I am able to replicate, using the MRP and the instructions. 👍 

Godot 4.6.1.stable - MacOS Tahoe 26.2 (25C56) - Apple M1 Pro - Forward+ - 16 GiB memory

~I'm working on a fix.~ Nevermind, someone else please take over... I am out of my depth!

## Stack trace

Please tag in if any of the below reasoning is inaccurate, this is my best effort to understand. 😌 

### Summary

Reading bottom-to-top:

1. **[14-12]** User clicks the resource picker button. `BaseButton::_pressed` fires, `EditorResourcePicker::_resource_selected` emits the `resource_selected` signal.
2. **[10-8]** Signal reaches `EditorPropertyResource::_resource_selected`, which toggles the unfold state and calls `update_property()`.
3. **[7]** `update_property()` creates the sub_inspector, calls `_open_editor_pressed()` which calls `edit_item()`. This transfers plugin ownership and triggers `fold_resource()` on another `EditorPropertyResource`, destroying part of the inspector tree.
4. **[6]** Back in `update_property()`, `sub_inspector->edit()` is called on the now-corrupted tree.
5. **[5-4]** `edit()` calls `update_tree()` calls `_parse_added_editors()` which tries to `add_child()` on a freed node.
6. **[2-1]** Crash in `Node::_add_child_nocheck`.
